when: ask:Role with a Zord Feature Perk

automation.notes: Use button: while Morphed, once per scene, spend 1 Personal Power and a Standard action to convert; your own Zord Feature Active Effects turn on until the scene ends or you're Defeated. Add Zord Features to yourself with the Add a Zord Feature picker.

source.book: Field Guide to Action and Adventure

system.prerequisite: Alt Mode, Personal Power Pool, Role with Zord Feature Perk, Size Class of at least Large
